title: Working in the Lab Late at Night

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Inner Voice)
scenarios.text: I'll work in the lab late at night. No one's here, so I can focus, and it'll just be the two of us...

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: Working late at night, it feels like grad school, so exciting ♪

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Inner Voice)
scenarios.text: I thought it would just be the two of us, but...

scenarios.speaker: Uda
scenarios.text: {{playerName}} Senpai, good work!

scenarios.speaker: Kjo
scenarios.text: Whoo, woo-hoo!↑↑

scenarios.speaker: Kchi
scenarios.text: Ugh, I'm so tired. Hey Uda-kun, cigarette.

scenarios.speaker: Uda
scenarios.text: Ah, I can't smoke right now.

scenarios.speaker: Tki
scenarios.text: I'm going too~

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Inner Voice)
scenarios.text: There are so many night owls here! My plan for just the two of us...

scenarios.speaker: system
scenarios.text: Starting to work despite the disappointment. In the lab, they decided to develop using vim.

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: Um... I don't really understand this vim thing... How do I type text?

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Dialogue)
scenarios.text: Ah, vim is difficult at first, isn't it? First, press 'i' to enter Insert mode...

scenarios.speaker: ShibaT
scenarios.text: Oh, you're using vim!

scenarios.speaker: ShibaT
scenarios.text: Megumi-chan, I'll teach you the tricks of vim~♪

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: Thank you, ShibaT Senpai!

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Inner Voice)
scenarios.text: I'm kind of jealous... Seeing ShibaT teaching Megumi-chan makes me feel uneasy.

scenarios.speaker: Protagonist (Dialogue)
scenarios.text: Hey, ShibaT! I'm Megumi's mentor! Work quietly!

scenarios.speaker: system
scenarios.text: The lab late at night was unexpectedly lively, creating an atmosphere where it was hard to concentrate on work. Megumi also seemed a bit bewildered.

scenarios.speaker: Megumi
scenarios.text: It's quite lively here, isn't it? It's getting late, so why don't we go get some food?

scenarios.speaker: system
scenarios.text: I wanted to go to an izakaya, but they're closed late at night... Where should we eat?
